name: Lyric Theatre, London
scope: The Lyric Theatre at 27–29 Shaftesbury Avenue, London, as photographed in April 2007, including its stage and auditorium envelope and the retained William Hunter house front on Great Windmill Street.

originalReview.notes: Oblique April 2007 view of the red brick and pale stone theatre front. It shows arched and pedimented attic openings, slate and chimneys, the dark LYRIC blade, the steep black canopy, timber doors and the Cabaret-era advertising board.

review.method: Exact Qualla original and named native public-domain release
review.notes: The exact April 2007 published original matches the file on Commons. Commons records the transfer of KF’s named English Wikipedia upload and KF’s worldwide public-domain release. The poster and contextual city images were outside the building-reference scope.
